source_title: Containers and Sandboxes are now generally available
claim_summary: Changelog declares Containers and Sandbox SDK generally available with active-CPU billing, Docker Hub images, SSH debugging, preview URLs and backup/restore; same-day press release frames it as Agent Cloud expansion
availability: GA per vendor; plan limits apply
limitation: Vendor GA label; InfoQ Apr 22 report relays vendor and customer claims without independent test; startup/cost claims unmeasured here

source_title: Project Think: building the next generation of AI agents on Cloudflare
claim_summary: Vendor previews next Agents SDK edition: durable fibers, sub-agents with own SQLite and typed RPC, persistent sessions and sandboxed code execution ladder
availability: preview; post says experimental and APIs may change
limitation: datePublished metadata only (no visible date); dateModified 2026-07-15 means page edited after publication

source_title: Artifacts: versioned storage that speaks Git
claim_summary: Git-compatible versioned storage for agents launched in private beta; post expected public beta in early May 2026 and says ArtifactFS driver is being open-sourced
limitation: Stated early-May public beta not evidenced; changelog records open beta only on 2026-10-01 (CI2026-038-025); ArtifactFS license not stated in post

source_title: Email Sending now in public beta
claim_summary: Email Sending moves from private to public beta under Cloudflare Email Service with Workers binding; requires Workers Paid plan
limitation: Beta only; deliverability and abuse controls not independently measured; a third-party summary reported a different REST path than the blog

product: Cloudflare network and Workers runtime deployment
source_title: Code Orange: Fail Small is complete. The result is a stronger Cloudflare network
claim_summary: Vendor reports completing progressive health-mediated config rollout (Snapstone), fail-stale defaults, and Workers runtime segmented by customer cohort after late-2025 outages
availability: internal process change reported by vendor
limitation: Claim that Nov/Dec 2025 outages would have been prevented is vendor assertion; no outage-rate reduction reported; underlying outages are pre-window

source_title: WAF and framework adapter mitigations for React and Next.js vulnerabilities
claim_summary: Existing managed WAF rules said to cover CVE-2026-23870 generically; Vinext requires React 19.2.6+; OpenNext adapter hardened; users told to upgrade React and Next.js since WAF cannot block every issue
availability: managed rules default-on; upgrades required by customers
limitation: URL slug says 2026-05-06 while page displays May 7; WAF coverage is vendor claim, not independent exploit test

product: Cloudflare Environments for Claude Managed Agents
source_title: Cloudflare Brings Secure, Scalable Sandboxes to Claude Managed Agents
claim_summary: Press release describes launch of Cloudflare Environments running Claude Managed Agents tool execution on Cloudflare Workers platform
availability: launch described; availability stage not stated
limitation: No counterparty quote on page; counterpart documentation not checked; this screen was produced with an Anthropic model so reviewer should check for bias

source_title: Call any AI model through AI Gateway's new REST API
claim_summary: AI Gateway uses AI REST API on api.cloudflare.com with universal /ai/run plus OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints and unified billing for third-party models
availability: available per changelog; stage label not stated
limitation: Compatibility claims not independently tested; unified billing shifts provider-key management to Cloudflare account

source_title: Agents SDK v0.14.0: Agent Skills, messengers, scheduled tasks, Workflows, and hardened chat recovery
claim_summary: Release adds on-demand Agent Skills catalog, Telegram messenger, typed scheduled tasks and Workflows integration
limitation: Experimental API may change; MIT-licensed cloudflare/agents repo but no independent task-quality evaluation

source_title: Cloudflare Acquires VoidZero to Build the Future of the AI-Native Web
claim_summary: Cloudflare states it has acquired VoidZero; Vite, Vitest, Rolldown, Oxc and Vite+ to remain MIT open source; USD 1 million independent Vite ecosystem fund
limitation: Forward-looking text references potential closing timing; vendor-neutrality pledge is a commitment not an observed outcome; Techzine Jun 5 relays claims with little critique

source_title: Deprecating Sandbox SDK features
claim_summary: HTTP/WebSocket transports, exposePort, default exec session and buffered APIs deprecated; Desktop already removed in 0.10.2; RPC transport recommended
availability: deprecations announced; no calendar removal dates
limitation: Migration burden on downstream users unmeasured; removal timeline not dated

source_title: Temporary accounts for AI agent deployments
claim_summary: Agents can deploy a Worker with wrangler --temporary to a preview account without sign-up; deployment lives 60 minutes unless claimed via claim URL
limitation: Abuse, security and data-retention implications not documented on page; stage label not stated

source_title: Your Worker can now have its own cache in front of it
claim_summary: Tiered cache placed in front of a Worker via one Wrangler config block; hits skip Worker execution and CPU billing but still count as requests
availability: available to every Worker on any plan per post
limitation: datePublished metadata only; 512 MB size limit described as temporary; cost savings depend on workload and are not measured here

source_title: Workflows pricing adds per-step billing. Step and storage billing to start no earlier than August 10, 2026.
claim_summary: Per-step billing added: Paid includes 500,000 steps/month then USD 0.80 per 100,000; Free 3,000 steps/day; step and storage billing no earlier than 2026-08-10
availability: announced; billing start no earlier than Aug 10
limitation: Actual billing start date after Aug 10 not verified in this screen

source_title: Cloudflare MCP servers support the new MCP 2026-07-28 Specification
claim_summary: Product MCP servers implement MCP 2026-07-28 stateless handling; legacy /sse URLs now route to Streamable HTTP so clients forcing SSE must switch
limitation: Client breakage risk for SSE-only clients; individual servers not named; conformance not independently tested

source_title: Select models now require the Workers Paid plan
claim_summary: Kimi K2.6, Kimi K2.7 Code and GLM-5.2 restricted to Workers Paid; Free plan requests return HTTP 403
limitation: Capacity rationale is vendor statement; reproducibility of free-tier experiments affected

source_title: Preview: @cloudflare/computer agent runtime
claim_summary: Early preview of open-source agent runtime switching between isolates and Linux containers with SQLite-backed virtual filesystem, shell, Git and AI SDK toolkit
limitation: License not stated on changelog page; preview API may change

source_title: Node.js compatibility is now enabled by default
claim_summary: Workers with compatibility date 2026-08-04 or later get Node.js compatibility automatically; opt-out via no_nodejs_compat flags
limitation: Existing Workers unchanged unless date bumped; npm package compatibility still workload-specific

source_title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
claim_summary: Vendor open-sources an agent workspace platform (cloudflare/cloudflare-os, Apache-2.0 per GitHub API) after internal employee use since May
availability: available on GitHub; managed version planned
limitation: Techstrong Aug 5 notes it effectively depends on Cloudflare network; no independent adoption evidence

source_title: Identity-aware controls are now available in AI Gateway
claim_summary: AI Gateway can sit behind Cloudflare Access and apply verified user identity (cf.user_id) to logs, routing and per-user spend limits
availability: available per changelog; plan limits not stated
limitation: Policy effectiveness not independently tested; adds identity data to logs

source_title: Run Cursor Cloud Agents on Cloudflare via self-hosted machines
claim_summary: Documented path to run Cursor Cloud Agents tool execution in Cloudflare Containers via an open-source Workers template
limitation: No partnership statement; counterpart documentation not checked; template license not checked

source_title: Test every pull request in an isolated environment with Worker Previews
claim_summary: Workers Builds can create a per-pull-request Preview with stable URL posted to the PR; Durable Objects and Containers isolated automatically
limitation: KV/D1/R2 are account-level so isolation needs separate bindings; Git host coverage not named on page

source_title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API
claim_summary: Open beta of cf CLI generated from API schema (Forge) covering the public API; after beta ends a final Wrangler major will redirect users and Wrangler gets 18 months maintenance
limitation: Wrangler end date depends on undated beta end; InfoQ Oct 6 cites community concern about TypeScript CLI dependencies

source_title: Sandbox SDK 1.0: control every sandbox from your own Durable Object
claim_summary: Sandbox SDK 1.0 available; 0.x receives bug and security fixes until 2026-12-31; snapshots and durable_object scheduling policy in public beta; policy change is one-way
limitation: Migration cost and one-way policy risk unmeasured; repo LICENSE text is Apache 2.0 but GitHub SPDX detection reports NOASSERTION

source_title: Artifacts is now in open beta
claim_summary: Artifacts open beta for Workers Paid customers; billing to begin 2026-10-14
limitation: Open beta arrives about five months after the early-May public-beta expectation in CI2026-038-003; Oct 14 billing date is outside window

source_title: Cloudflare OS: your company's agent workspace, managed for you
claim_summary: Vendor opens waitlist for fully managed Cloudflare OS deployments; open-source self-deploy remains
availability: waitlist only; no date, SLA or pricing
limitation: No launch date or commercial terms; do not treat as shipped

source_title: Run OpenCode 2.0 on Cloudflare with the Agents SDK
claim_summary: Experimental OpenCodeHarness runs OpenCode in a Durable Object with SQLite sessions and Workers AI models; requires Agents SDK 0.28.0+
limitation: No partnership statement; experimental; on window boundary date
